title: Mechanistic insights into global suppressors of protein folding defects
authors: Chattopadhyay G; Bhowmick J; Manjunath K; Ahmed S; Goyal P; Varadarajan R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蛋白质折叠缺陷的全局抑制子机制，聚焦蛋白稳定性与再折叠，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Most amino acid substitutions in a protein either lead to partial loss of function or are near neutral. Several studies have shown the existence of second-site mutations that can rescue defects caused by diverse loss of function mutations. Such global suppressor mutations are key drivers of protein evolution. However, the mechanisms responsible for such suppression remain poorly understood. To address this, we characterized multiple suppressor mutations both in isolation and in combination with inactive mutants. We examined six global suppressors of the bacterial toxin CcdB, the known M182T global suppressor of TEM-1 β-lactamase, the N239Y global suppressor of p53-DBD and three suppressors of the SARS-CoV-2 spike Receptor Binding Domain. The suppressors both alone, and in conjunction with inactive mutants, stabilise the protein both thermodynamically and kinetically in-vitro , predominantly through acceleration of the refolding rate. When coupled to inactive mutants they promote increased in-vivo solubilities as well as regain-of-function phenotypes. In the case of CcdB, where novel suppressors were isolated, we determined the crystal structures of three such suppressors to obtain insight into the specific molecular interactions responsible for the observed effects. While most individual suppressors result in small stability enhancements relative to wildtype, which can be combined to yield significant stability increases, thermodynamic stabilisation is neither necessary nor sufficient for suppressor action.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质中大多数氨基酸替换要么导致功能部分丧失，要么接近中性。多项研究表明，存在第二位点突变可以挽救由多种功能丧失突变引起的缺陷。这类全局抑制子突变是蛋白质进化的关键驱动因素。然而，此类抑制作用的机制仍知之甚少。为解决这一问题，我们分别表征了多个抑制子突变，既单独研究，也与失活突变体结合研究。我们检查了细菌毒素CcdB的六个全局抑制子、已知的TEM-1 β-内酰胺酶全局抑制子M182T、p53-DBD的N239Y全局抑制子，以及SARS-CoV-2刺突受体结合域的三个抑制子。这些抑制子单独存在或与失活突变体结合时，在体外均能通过主要加速重折叠速率，在热力学和动力学上稳定蛋白质。当与失活突变体偶联时，它们促进体内溶解度增加并恢复功能表型。在CcdB案例中，我们分离了新型抑制子，并确定了其中三个抑制子的晶体结构，以深入了解负责观察效应的特定分子相互作用。虽然大多数单个抑制子相对于野生型仅产生较小的稳定性增强，这些增强可以组合以产生显著的稳定性提升，但热力学稳定化既非抑制子作用的必要条件，也非充分条件。
